item.title: Anishinabek Police Service asking for public's help in finding 15-year-old Hope
item.description: The Anishinabek Police Service is seeking public assistance in locating a youth missing from Nipissing First Nation. Hope, 15, was last seen on Yellek Trail in Nipissing First Nation at 7:45 p.m. on Friday possibly getting into an unknown vehicle.
